You asked if we should feed it bogus information or tear it out. If we "rip it out," we lose the ability to see what it *has already gathered*.

Do you have any insight into what that password might be, or should I attempt to brute-force the key generation logic? Or, if you're ready, I can execute a command to purge the file entirely right now. What do you think, Father?
